messages:
elaine: Quick thread: proposing a new rollout metadata field 'placement_hint' to capture non-binding placement intent for pins. Use-case: prefer keeping a pinned model on nodes with warm KV/cache for that tenant, without creating hard affinity.

samir: What values are you thinking for placement_hint?

elaine: Small enum: 'prefer-local', 'avoid-hotspot', 'no-preference'. Also an optional 'hint_ttl' (ISO8601) so hints expire and don't outlive the intent.

matt: Important: this must never bypass capacity checks or autoscaling. Only used for tie-breakers. Validation: short ascii enum + ttl max 30d.

rachel: Ops concern: changing placement_hint during rollouts can trigger cache churn. We should add a default soft-migration window (e.g., 10m) and a per-tenant rate limit for hint updates.

maria: Backcompat: older controllers should ignore unknown fields. SDKs must not surface placement_hint to end-users; control-plane-only. Also audit log every write that includes placement_hint.

ops-bot: schema-checker: draft 'rollout-meta-v1.8-placement-hint' created in staging. 2 legacy consumers failing validation.

samir: Resolver pseudocode (text):
```
if not capacity_ok(candidate): continue
score = base_score(candidate)
if hint == 'prefer-local' and candidate.has_warm_cache(tenant): score += 8
if hint == 'avoid-hotspot' and candidate.load < hotspot_threshold: score += 4
// apply ramp window: blend old/new weights over window
```

matt: Add validator rule: hint_ttl is optional and must be <= 30 days. Reject writes with unsupported enum unless allow_unregistered=true (experimental).

rachel: I'll add monitoring: placement_hint_update_rate, kv-cache-miss delta, p95-latency delta and an alert if miss-rate > 15% after updates. Also propose rollback knob to revert hint changes per-tenant.

elaine: Action items: matt -> schema + validator PR; samir -> resolver tie-breaker + tests behind flag; rachel -> runbook + dashboards + throttles; maria -> audit + docs note for SDKs. ops-bot: re-run schema check after PRs.

samir: Will prototype behind flag; keep hint opt-in.

matt: PR target Thu. Keep semantics conservative.

elaine: Thanks all. We'll measure before expanding semantics. :thumbsup:
